nodes.label: Dual-Engine Architecture
nodes.rationale: All findings must be computed deterministically in code with exact source references; LLMs are used only to translate verified findings into explanations. This guarantees zero hallucinated or fabricated findings and no fabricated compliance evidence.

nodes.label: Engine 1: Deterministic Rule Engine
nodes.rationale: Findings, risk scores, secret matches, permission flags, package checks and gap flags are computed with deterministic regex, AST, matrix and assertion logic and emitted as structured JSON with exact source references, so no LLM can fabricate a finding.

nodes.label: Engine 2: LLM Explanation Layer
nodes.rationale: LLMs only translate verified deterministic findings into plain-English summaries, remediation prompts and checklists; they never invent findings, alter risk scores, or modify citations.

nodes.label: Evidence Gap Flagging (UNSUPPORTED_GAP)
nodes.rationale: Questionnaire answers without supporting evidence are explicitly flagged instead of drafted, to prevent fraudulent compliance attestations.

nodes.label: Exact Source Citations (file, line, snippet, rule_id)
nodes.norm_label: exact source citations (file, line, snippet, rule_id)
nodes.rationale: Every finding and answer carries an exact file and line-level reference so it can be verified against the source.

nodes.label: Shared Core Pipeline (Ingest -> RulePack -> Explain)
nodes.rationale: One deterministic Python core engine is shared by all four products instead of each product owning its own scan pipeline.

nodes.label: Swappable Explainer Adapter (Mock default, Gemini / OpenAI)
nodes.norm_label: swappable explainer adapter (mock default, gemini / openai)
nodes.rationale: Mock mode is the default so the suite runs without live LLM keys; a live Gemini or OpenAI provider can be swapped in behind the same adapter.

nodes.label: MOCK_BILLING Mode
nodes.rationale: MOCK_BILLING=true by default so Stripe upgrade checkout sessions can be tested locally without a credit card or live keys; the real Stripe client activates when MOCK_BILLING=false and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is provided.
